summary: Frontend-only verification of the CRM-card refactor to the shared ProductionTelegramPanel plus parity with the Production card, order 'Test Direct URL' (CRM-2164B233). CRM flow: login admin/admin123 -> Sauna -> Wybierz -> crm-tab-btn -> 'Список' -> search 'Test Direct URL' -> card. CRM card renders exactly ONE prod-tg-panel (no duplicates, no white screen): prod-ack-status '✅ Производство приняло: Ext2 · 14.08.2026, 21:08:24' + 'Дата производства: 15.09.2026', production-photo-gallery with 1 thumb, prod-messages-section with feed + composer, 'Вся переписка (4)'. Lightbox opens (counter '1/1', prev/next correctly hidden for single photo) and closes via lightbox-close. Chat-history dialog (exactly 1 instance in DOM): 4 messages, search 'zzzznotfound' -> 0 msgs + 'Ничего не найдено', search 'QA' -> 2 msgs; PDF/TXT export buttons open new tabs and both endpoints verified via curl (TXT 200 text/plain 729B with correct Russian transcript, PDF 200 application/pdf 69.6KB); quick reply sent -> message count 4->5 and text visible in dialog; Escape closes dialog. CRM composer send: message appended to feed, input cleared, counter 5->6. Production card parity (Produkcja saun -> Канбан -> 'Test Direct URL'): same single panel, same ack badge/photo/lightbox, dialog shows 6 messages including both messages sent from the CRM card (search 'QA crm' -> 2), composer send shows toast 'Сообщение отправлено в тему', feed updates, counter 6->7. All 5 requested scenarios pass in both cards.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' logged on render of both pages (pre-existing, also reported in iteration_124). No functional impact observed.

action_items: Fix missing/duplicate React key in the .map() rendering of SaunaCRMPage and SaunaProductionPage (console error on every card render).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionTelegramPanel keeps local `lead` state synced only on order.id / productionMessages.length / lastProductionUpdateAt / productionAckedAt changes; if the parent refetches the same order with edited (not added) messages or new photos, the panel shows stale data until the card is reopened (still open from iteration_124).
CRM list-view search Input had no data-testid; added data-testid="crm-list-search" (kanban view uses crm-search) — needed for automation.
seed_data_creation: 3 test messages appended to order CRM-2164B233 productionMessages by send tests ('QA crm reply <ts>', 'QA crm composer <ts>', 'QA prod parity <ts>'); message count now 7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State-based SPA navigation (no URL routes). CRM card: login -> click 'Sauna' -> 'Wybierz' -> data-testid crm-tab-btn -> tab 'Список' -> fill [data-testid="crm-list-search"] with 'Test Direct URL' -> click [data-testid="list-lead-CRM-2164B233"]. Production card: 'Produkcja saun' -> 'Wybierz' -> 'Канбан' -> click text 'Test Direct URL'. Note: selector [data-testid^="production-photo-"] also matches production-photo-gallery — use production-photo-0 for the thumb. Toast (sonner) auto-dismisses; poll li[data-sonner-toast] within ~3s of the send click. Order CRM-2164B233 now has 7 productionMessages, 1 production photo.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — refactor verified working in both cards; only the pre-existing React key warning remains.
